_doc: Every chance the game's rules roll for a reward (scripts/systems/roll_system.gd, Game.rolls.roll(id, base)), in one place. vip: whether active VIP multiplies it (VipSystem.chance: by the boost, never over certain; docs/VIP.md). Turning VIP on or off for a roll is this flag, nothing else. A roll used in code and missing here, or listed here and used nowhere, fails tests/suites/rolls_test.gd. what: the roll, for people. cap: at most `most` of it come up a day or a week (per: day or week, from local midnight; owner 19 Nov: caps so no reward runs away on a big farm).
